title: Category
description: Product category for organizing and classifying items in an e-commerce store. Supports hierarchical categories with parent-child relationships, visual styling, and item counts.

name.description: Display name of the category (e.g., Electronics, Clothing, Books)

slug.description: URL-friendly identifier for the category used in web addresses

description.description: Brief description of what products belong to this category

parent_id.description: ID of the parent category if this is a subcategory, null for top-level categories

order.description: Display order or sort position for the category in listings

icon.description: Icon identifier or name for visual representation of the category

color.description: Hex color code or color name for category branding and visual distinction

items_count.description: Total number of products currently assigned to this category

created_at.description: Timestamp when the category was created
